messages:
Aisha Patel: Heads up — since ~09:10 UTC we’ve seen provisioning/backfill jobs stuck for customers on Private (VPC) deploys. Impact: activations delayed, onboarding webhooks queued, and some tenants aren’t getting the final ‘ready’ callback. I’ve pulled a list of ~12 affected tenants. Need comms + enablement plan. @Marco can you draft an initial customer note?

Marco Diaz: On it. Draft below — short and transparent. Share feedback please.

Marco Diaz: Dear <Customer>, we’re investigating delayed activation and onboarding callbacks for Private deployments. Some background: a scaling regression in our VPC worker autoscaler caused backfill jobs to queue. Mitigation is underway; most customers will see activations complete within 2 hours. We’ll follow up with an RCA and credits where applicable. — Redwood CS

Lena Cho: +1 on that tone. Can we add a short bullet for immediate next steps and who to contact for urgent replays? e.g., "If you need a manual replay, reply here or contact cs@redwood.com"

Marco Diaz: Good call. Updated: added manual replay contact and an ETA window (1–3 hrs).

Samir Bhandari: Tech update — root cause: regression in the VPCExecutor scaling logic (merged in rollout-2026-03-22). Autoscaler stopped spawning new worker pods once queue depth exceeded 8 for certain instance types. I’ve pushed a hotfix (revert + backoff tuning) and triggered an on-demand scale. We should see worker count rise in the next ~4–6min.

Aisha Patel: ETA for backlog drain? Any risk to data integrity?

Samir Bhandari: Backlog drainage ETA ~30–90min for each tenant depending on queue size. No data loss risk — jobs are durable in the queue. We’ll prioritize tenants flagged as high-touch.

Lena Cho: I’ll open office hours for affected customers at 11:30 UTC and a follow-up Q&A doc in the KB. Who can join to help triage live replays? @Samir you in for 11:30?

Samir Bhandari: I can do 11:30–12:30 UTC. Will bring traces and the patch summary.

Marco Diaz: Draft customer message ready for send — can we get a quick legal-approved blurb about credits? If not, I’ll say "we’ll offer credits where impact meets our SLA"

Aisha Patel: That phrasing is fine for now. I’ll loop legal if customers escalate. Sending draft to the 12 tenants in segments in ~10m.

deploy-bot: [action] restart/autoscaler-hotfix applied by Samir Bhandari — job 7843. New replicas: 12 -> 24.

Marco Diaz: Sending first batch now. Copy of message I’m posting: ```Hi there — we detected delayed activations for your Private deployment due to an autoscaler issue. We’ve applied a fix and expect activations to finish within 1–3 hours. If you’d like a manual replay sooner, reply here or email cs@redwood.com. We will follow up with a technical RCA and proposed credits if applicable. — Aisha from Redwood CS```

Aisha Patel: Tagging renewal-risk owners: will mark any tenant with activations delayed >6hrs as "renewal-monitor" and prioritize outreach. Marco, please add a flag to the CRM notes.

Marco Diaz: Flagging in CRM now. Also adding "office-hours" invite link and a short feedback ask in the follow-up: a 1-question survey about impact and expectations.

Lena Cho: I’ll own the feedback capture doc and the KB triage steps. Putting a template for manual replay commands in the doc: 

Lena Cho: ```# Manual replay steps
1) curl -X POST https://internal.replay/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/replay 
2) monitor logs: kubectl -n vpc-tenant logs -f replay-worker-{id}
3) confirm webhook delivered: check webhook.delivery_events table
```

Samir Bhandari: Will add a short runbook note for oncall — patch backported to v1.2.3, monitoring alert thresholds relaxed to avoid false positives.

Aisha Patel: Thanks everyone. Postmortem items: immediate RCA (tech writeup), customer-facing RCA (lay terms), credits decision, renewal-monitor outreach, and feedback roundup. Please add your action items to the thread.

Marco Diaz: Action: send customer batches (in progress).

Lena Cho: Action: KB + feedback doc (in progress).

Samir Bhandari: Action: full RCA draft + telemetry graphs (ETA today EOD).

Aisha Patel: I’ll coordinate exec summary and renewal-risk queue. Will follow up in this thread with customers list and CRM links.
